title: Login Success with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a user with valid credentials can successfully log in and is redirected to the Unified Dashboard in Arabic RTL layout.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username and password.
Click the login button.
Confirm login is successful and user is redirected to the Unified Dashboard.
Verify the dashboard displays correct branch and financial metrics in Arabic RTL layout.

title: Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails with invalid credentials and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username or incorrect password.
Click the login button.
Confirm login is not successful.
Verify that an error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed.

title: Unified Dashboard Branch Overview Accuracy
description: Validate that the Unified Dashboard correctly displays all branches, showrooms, warehouses, and outlets with their key metrics in Arabic RTL layout.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the Unified Dashboard.
Verify all branches, showrooms, warehouses, and outlets are listed according to the database records.
Validate key metrics for each branch (e.g., status, financial data) are shown accurately.
Confirm the interface is properly rendered in Arabic RTL layout.

title: Branch Management - Create New Branch
description: Verify that a user can create a new branch with all required details and the branch appears correctly in the hierarchy.

steps.description: Navigate to Branch Management module.
Click on create new branch option.
Fill in branch details including name, location hierarchy, and set active status.
Submit the creation form.
Confirm branch is created and visible in the branch list with correct details.
Verify the location hierarchy and active status are saved correctly.

title: Branch Management - Edit Branch Details
description: Validate the editing of an existing branch's details including location hierarchy and status toggling.

steps.description: Navigate to Branch Management module.
Select an existing branch and open edit view.
Modify branch details such as name, location hierarchy, and active status.
Save the changes.
Confirm updated details are reflected in the branch list and hierarchy.
Verify toggling active status properly activates or deactivates the branch.

title: Branch Management - Delete Branch
description: Verify that deleting a branch removes it from the system and updates the location hierarchy appropriately.

steps.description: Navigate to Branch Management module.
Select a branch and initiate deletion.
Confirm the deletion action.
Confirm the branch is removed and no longer appears in the branch list.
Verify location hierarchy is updated to remove the deleted branch.

title: Chart of Accounts - Create and Edit Accounts
description: Verify users can create hierarchical accounts including various account types and edit their details correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to Chart of Accounts management.
Create a new account under a parent account specifying account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense).
Save the new account.
Verify the account is visible under the correct hierarchy with proper account type.
Edit the created account to update name and account type.
Save the changes.
Confirm the updates are reflected correctly in the Chart of Accounts view.

title: Journal Entries - Create, Save Draft, Post, and Reverse
description: Verify creating journal entries, saving drafts, posting entries, reversing posted entries, and performing bulk journal operations.

steps.description: Navigate to Journal Entries module.
Create a new journal entry with valid debit and credit lines.
Save the entry as draft.
Verify the entry is saved with draft status.
Post the saved draft entry.
Confirm the entry status changes to posted.
Reverse the posted journal entry.
Verify a reversal entry is created correctly linked to the original.
Select multiple journal entries and perform bulk post or reverse operations.
Confirm all selected entries are processed correctly without errors.

title: Financial Reports Accuracy and Generation
description: Check Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, Trial Balance, and General Ledger report generation with up-to-date and accurate data.

steps.description: Navigate to Financial Reports section.
Generate each report: Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow, Trial Balance, General Ledger.
Validate that all reports load without errors.
Verify reported values match expected data from journal entries and chart of accounts.

title: Cost Center Management - Budget Creation and Expense Allocation
description: Verify creating cost centers with budgets, allocating expenses to cost centers, and viewing cost center reports.

steps.description: Navigate to Cost Centers management.
Create a new cost center with a specified budget.
Confirm cost center is created with the correct budget.
Record expense allocations against the created cost center.
Verify expenses are correctly allocated and reflected in cost center reports.

title: Bank Management - Account CRUD and Reconciliation
description: Verify creation, editing, and deletion of bank accounts, importing bank statements, and reconciling transactions accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to Bank Management module.
Create a new bank account with required details.
Confirm the bank account appears in the list with correct details.
Edit the bank account details.
Verify changes are reflected correctly.
Import a bank statement file in supported format.
Verify bank transactions are imported without errors.
Perform bank reconciliation by matching imported transactions with existing ledger entries.
Confirm reconciliation status and matched transactions are correct.
Delete the bank account.
Confirm the account is deleted and removed from lists.

title: Cash Management - Receipts, Payments, and Transfers
description: Verify that cash receipts, payments, and internal transfers between treasuries and banks are recorded and reflected correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to Cash Management module.
Create a new cash receipt transaction.
Confirm receipt is saved and reflected in cash position.
Create a new cash payment transaction.
Verify payment is recorded correctly.
Perform an internal transfer between treasury and bank accounts.
Verify transfer is recorded and balances updated accurately.

title: Cheque Portfolio Management CRUD Operations
description: Test the creation, viewing, editing, and deletion of cheques within the cheque portfolio module.

steps.description: Navigate to Cheque Management module.
Create a new cheque with all required fields.
Confirm cheque is listed with correct details.
View the cheque details page.
Verify cheque details are accurate.
Edit the cheque information.
Confirm changes are saved properly.
Delete the cheque.
Verify cheque is removed from the cheque list.

title: Loan Management - Loan Creation and Payment Tracking
description: Verify the creation of loans, viewing loan details, and tracking payments schedules on the loan dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to Loan Management dashboard.
Create a new loan with principal, term, interest rate, and repayment schedule.
Confirm the loan appears in the loan list with correct details.
View loan details including payment history and outstanding balance.
Verify payment schedules and balance are accurate.

title: Revenue and Expense Entries with Filters
description: Test creation of revenue and expense entries and validate reports filtered by supplier and owner.

steps.description: Navigate to Revenue & Expense Entry management.
Create a new revenue entry with supplier selected and valid amount.
Confirm the revenue entry is saved successfully.
Create a new expense entry with owner selected.
Verify expense entry is recorded correctly.
Generate reports filtered by supplier.
Confirm report content contains only entries related to selected supplier.
Generate reports filtered by owner.
Ensure report includes only entries related to the selected owner.

title: Electronic Payment Accounts Management
description: Validate CRUD operations for electronic payment accounts such as Fawry and Visa.

steps.description: Navigate to Electronic Accounts management.
Add a new electronic payment account with valid details.
Verify the new account appears in the list with accurate details.
Edit existing electronic payment account information.
Confirm edited information is saved and displayed properly.
Delete an electronic payment account.
Check the account is removed from the list.

title: Treasury Management CRUD Operations
description: Verify creation, editing, and deletion of treasury cash storage locations.

steps.description: Navigate to Treasury Management.
Create a new treasury location with required data.
Validate the treasury appears in the list with correct information.
Edit treasury details.
Verify edited details are updated properly.
Delete a treasury location.
Confirm the treasury is removed from the listing.

title: Account Transfers with Approval Workflow
description: Verify that users can perform transfers between accounts and that transfers undergo required approval processes.

steps.description: Navigate to Account Transfers module.
Create a new transfer from bank to treasury or between banks.
Confirm the transfer request is recorded and awaits approval.
Login as an approver and approve the pending transfer.
Verify the transfer status updates to completed.
Check account balances are adjusted accordingly post approval.

title: Product Costing - Cost Analysis and History Tracking
description: Validate that product costing calculations are correct, cost components can be managed, and historical costing data is tracked.

steps.description: Navigate to Product Costing module.
Add or update cost components for a product.
Verify the cost analysis for the product updates accordingly.
View cost history for a product.
Confirm historical costing data is displayed accurately with timestamps.
Perform a bulk update of product costs.
Ensure bulk updates apply correctly with no data inconsistencies.

title: Fixed Assets Management and Depreciation Calculations
description: Verify fixed asset creation, editing, and depreciation calculations for multiple methods including straight-line, declining balance, and sum of years.

steps.description: Navigate to Fixed Assets Management.
Create a new fixed asset with necessary details.
Confirm asset is saved and appears in the asset list.
Select depreciation method and apply depreciation calculations.
Verify depreciation values are calculated accurately as per selected method.
Edit asset details and recalculate depreciation.
Ensure depreciation updates reflect changes correctly.

title: Data Export Functionality
description: Check exporting data in CSV, Excel, and PDF formats from accounts, journal entries, customers, suppliers, invoices, and purchase bills.

steps.description: Navigate to Export Tools.
Select entity type such as accounts or journal entries.
Choose export format: CSV, Excel, or PDF.
Perform the export.
Validate the file downloads and contains complete and correct data matching the current records.
Ensure file format is correct and opens without error in appropriate applications.

title: Quick Operations - Bulk Price and Inventory Updates
description: Validate bulk operations dashboard can update prices and inventory for multiple products accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to Quick Operations dashboard.
Select bulk price update operation and specify criteria.
Execute bulk price update.
Confirm prices of selected products are updated accordingly.
Select bulk inventory update operation.
Perform inventory update.
Verify inventory quantities are adjusted correctly.

title: Quick Operations - Bulk Email and Delete
description: Verify bulk email sending and bulk delete operations function correctly with proper confirmation and error handling.

steps.description: Navigate to Quick Operations dashboard.
Select multiple entries and choose bulk email operation.
Send bulk emails.
Verify emails are sent and user receives confirmation.
Select multiple entries for bulk deletion.
Confirm the bulk delete action.
Verify selected entries are deleted from the system.

title: Financial Analysis - Ratio Reports and Budget Comparison
description: Validate financial ratio reports and budget versus actual expense comparisons generate accurate data and display correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to Financial Analysis section.
Generate ratio reports.
Confirm ratio reports display accurate calculations based on current financial data.
Generate budget versus actual expense comparison reports.
Verify that budget variances are reported correctly with proper formatting.

title: UI Consistency and RTL Layout Validation
description: Verify that all user interface views including dashboard, management modules, and reports are fully adapted to Arabic RTL layout with consistent alignment and navigation.

steps.description: Navigate through main dashboard and all major modules: Branch Management, Accounting Dashboard, Reports, Cost Centers, Bank Management.
Confirm the interface renders in right-to-left orientation consistently.
Check that text alignment, navigation arrows, and menus follow RTL conventions.
Verify no broken layouts, overlapping elements, or misaligned text across screens.
